figures.approximateFootprint: x about245-665 and y1045-1350 on existing grid; caption below near y1390. Detail box includes full drawing but not caption or165.

items.observation: One vertically elongated closed lens-shaped section. Left face bows leftward, right face bows rightward, meeting at pointed top and bottom. Middle thickness greater than the joined ends. All outline strokes solid, no dashed surface or additional footprint.

One solid near-horizontal line, slightly rising to the right with the scan. It passes through lens, continues beyond both sides, and extends beyond both outer center marks. No arrowhead on the axis itself.
Filled point on axis outside lens to left, labelled O with visibly small subscript1 below/right. Upper slanted line starts at this point.
Filled point on axis inside lens between its two surface crossings, labelled O just above it without a subscript.
Filled point on axis outside lens to right, labelled O with visibly small subscript2. Lower slanted line starts at this point.
Label A below/left of the axis crossing with the left curved face. Crossing is a joined outline/axis intersection, not an added isolated dot or circle.
Label B above/right of axis crossing with the right curved face. No separate isolated dot or circle at this crossing.

Solid oblique line from left O_1 point rises rightward across left curved face above axis, and terminates on right curved face above axis. A filled arrowhead on the interior upper portion points right/up toward that right-face endpoint.
R with subscript1 is placed above the exterior left part of the upper diagonal, between O_1 and lens.

Solid oblique line from right O_2 point runs left/down across right curved face below axis and terminates on left curved face below axis. Filled arrowhead on the interior lower portion points left/down toward the left-face endpoint; detail separates it from the nearby R label.
R with subscript2 is inside lens below O and above/along the lower diagonal. Subscript2 is visible, not a prime or subscript1.

Axis point order is O_1, left-face crossing A, interior O, right-face crossing B, O_2. Upper diagonal is based at O_1 and reaches opposite/right face; lower is based at O_2 and reaches opposite/left face. Diagonals do not meet each other in the lens. Their boundary crossing points other than A/B carry no additional definite name or point marker.

Sparse short oblique hatch-like dark clusters inside lens around upper/lower regions and either side of center. They remain distinct material-like ink, not added axis/ticks/rays or labels. Exact number of constituent short pen strokes is not robustly counted.

Seven definite labels: O_1, O, O_2, A, B, R_1, R_2. Three isolated filled axis points, two curve/axis crossings and two unlabelled diagonal endpoints. No printed numeric radius, measured angle, degree arc, dashed normal or extra named point.

Entire left axis end/O_1 label, right axis end/O_2 label, top/bottom lens tips, A/B/R labels and both radius arrowheads are visible. 图 164 caption separated below. No165 or surrounding prose ink inside this drawing.

figures.approximateFootprint: x about730-1130 and y1075-1340. Three separate vertically oriented sections left-to-right, one shared caption below near y1400.

items.observation: Left section is a thin crescent/meniscus-like closed shape: two right-bowing curved faces join at upper and lower tips, with a narrow positive thickness through middle. Left face is also curved, not a straight plane; right face projects farther right.
Middle section is a closed double-convex form: left face bows left, right face bows right, top/bottom tips join and middle is thicker. Not a rectangle, circle or pair of detached arcs.
Right section has a near-straight vertical left face and a right-bowing convex right face meeting at top/bottom; one planar-looking face and one curved face, with central thickness.

Three unconnected shapes in one row, crescent-like left, double-convex middle, plano-convex-like right. Wide white gaps. Similar vertical orientation and comparable heights, not an exact equality/scale assertion.

Each of all three sections contains sparse short oblique dark hatch-like clusters, distributed down its interior. No beam, arrow, axis, numerical value or named/dotted point is visible in any of the three.
All boundary curves and left plane-like edge are solid. No dashed construction, centerline, surface normal or labelled panel letter.
All three top/bottom tips and both sides visible, one group caption 图 165 below center. Figure164 axis/labels at left,166 at right and prose beneath are outside the group.

remainingLimits.scope: Absolute radii, optical power, material index and exact cross-section dimensions are not printed or measured; not inferred from lens theory.
Exact small hatch constituent-stroke counts are not mathematical claims.
